title: Drug Use-Results Survey on Picoprep® Combination Powder
brief_summary: The purpose of this survey is to confirm safety and efficacy with patients who are administered the Picoprep® for cleansing of intestinal contents for preparation of colonoscopy and colorectal surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Patients who are administered the Picoprep® for cleansing of intestinal contents for preparation of colonoscopy and colorectal surgery.
study_population: Patients being prepared for colonoscopy and colorectal surgery
